package main

import "testing"

var scalarSink float64

func directGoScalar() float64 {
	total := 0.0
	for index := 0; index < 20_000_000; index++ {
		total = total + float64(index)*0.0000001
	}
	return total
}

func BenchmarkScalarOct(b *testing.B) {
	if got, want := fn_Main_main(), directGoScalar(); got != want {
		b.Fatalf("generated result %g differs from Go %g", got, want)
	}
	for b.Loop() {
		scalarSink = fn_Main_main()
	}
}

func BenchmarkScalarGo(b *testing.B) {
	for b.Loop() {
		scalarSink = directGoScalar()
	}
}
